system.description:
GM marker: this creature or object radiates Holy. Drop it on a token to mark it.

The marker shows no icon to players. It appears as a colored glow around the token — visible to the GM, and to any player whose character bears a Detection (Holy) boon.

effects.name: Detection Aura (Holy)
effects.description: Radiates Holy. Perceived only through the Detection (Holy) boon (or by the GM).
